$note: AirKenya Express 2027 route network - companion file to flights-air-kenya-routes-2026.json. Structurally very similar to 2026 but with two material changes: (1) a new separate 'Fuel Surcharge' column added on top of gross/nett/tax, (2) Group Fare thresholds changed (2026: 10+pax=20%, 16+pax=25% vs 2027: 15+pax=20%, 20+pax=25%). Also includes two standalone special-fare sheets (Mara S Class, Arusha J Class) not present in the 2026 folder.
carrier: AirKenya Express (with Regional Air Services Tanzania, Aerolink Uganda as connecting sister airlines)

source.sClassFile: 2027 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/FLIGHTS/AIR KENYA/AIRKENYA 2027 RATES S CLASS 15%.pdf
source.jClassFile: 2027 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/FLIGHTS/AIR KENYA/AIRKENYA 2027 RATES J CLASS 15%.pdf
source.extractionMethod: Main rates PDF's rate-table pages (2-7) are image-only (scanned), same as the 2026 file - extracted via direct visual read of each page image. The S Class and J Class one-page PDFs are ALSO image-only (pdftotext returns empty) - also extracted visually.

newFor2027.fuelSurcharge: A new *FUEL SUR-CHARGE (USD) column appears on every route table, additional to Gross/Nett/Taxes. Per the T&Cs page: 'The fuel surcharge is subject to periodic review and may be revised based on prevailing market conditions and fuel price stability.' This means the 2027 all-in cost per route is HIGHER than the nett-fare-only figures below would suggest - always add the fuel surcharge when computing a real quote total.
newFor2027.returnFareRestriction: New restriction not present in the 2026 doc: 'Return fares are only applicable where both the inbound and outbound sectors are to and from the same destination' - i.e. you can't mix a return fare across two different airstrips.
newFor2027.sustainabilityMessaging: Marketing copy now includes an eTA/e-visa and Yellow Fever vaccination reminder for the Mara-Serengeti (vv) connection - a genuinely new compliance note worth passing to travelers on that specific route.
newFor2027.arushaDirectAccess: Letter highlights new/enhanced direct access to Arusha as a 2027 product improvement.
newFor2027.aircraftMix: ~70% of scheduled-circuit passengers now fly Dash 8 / Dash 7 (pressurized) per the cover letter, up from the 2026 letter's more modest fleet-upgrade framing.

wilsonAmboseli.note: IDENTICAL gross/nett/tax to the 2026 figures (see flights-air-kenya-routes-2026.json) - only the new fuel surcharge is additive. Daily; min 2 pax. Inbound Amboseli-Wilson connects to Nanyuki, Lewa Downs, Samburu, Meru, Loisaba at 09:45; Masai Mara at 10:30; Arusha at 13:30.

wilsonArusha.note: Same route AirKenya called 'Wilson-Kilimanjaro' in the 2026 doc, now relabeled 'Arusha' in 2027 (both are the international sector requiring min 4 pax) - gross/nett figures identical to 2026's Kilimanjaro figures, tax figures also identical. Non-operational 1 Apr-20 May and 1 Nov-15 Dec, same as 2026.

lewaSamburuLoisabaMeruToMasaiMara.note: 2027 consolidates what was 3 separate route rows in 2026 (Lewa/Samburu-Mara, Loisaba-Mara, Meru-Mara) into one combined 'LEWA/SAMBURU/LOISABA/MERU - MASAI MARA' row, same fare.

wilsonMasaiMara.note: Identical to 2026 gross/nett/tax; 'Wilson-Masai Mara Special' promo-fare row from the 2026 doc does not appear as a separate line in the 2027 main contract - see marasClassSpecial2027 below, likely its successor/replacement.

maraToMigori.note: Vice versa (vv). Identical to 2026 gross/nett/tax. Daily except non-operational 1 Apr-20 May, min 4 pax 1 Nov-15 Dec.

maraToTarime.note: Vice versa. NEW for 2027: 'This service includes road transfer on Airkenya buses between Migori-Tarime (vv)' - explicitly bundled ground transfer, not mentioned in the 2026 doc's equivalent row.

maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarime.note: Fares apply between AirKenya and either Regional Air Services, Auric Air, or Coastal Aviation, either direction. Daily, min 2 pax except non-operational 1 Apr-20 May and min 4 pax 1 Nov-15 Dec. NEW for 2027: fares now explicitly stated to be 'inclusive of transfers between Migori-Tarime and Tarime-Migori, provided by Airkenya.' New visa/health compliance note added (Kenya eTA, Tanzania e-visa, Yellow Fever certificate mandatory for East Africa travel).
maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarime.note2: All gross/nett/tax figures identical to 2026 - only the fuel surcharge column and the transfer-inclusion/visa notes are new.

maraSClass.title: Mara Special Rates - S Class
maraSClass.confidenceNote: This is a separate, cheaper promotional fare class specific to named flight times, similar in spirit to the 2026 'Wilson-Masai Mara Special' row but issued here as its own standalone one-page sheet rather than embedded in the main contract table. Circuit and Group discounts do NOT apply to S Class. S Class inventory is unavailable during peak season (July-August). Company may withdraw/amend/discontinue without notice.

arushaJClass.title: Arusha Special Rates - J Class 2027
arushaJClass.confidenceNote: Separate promotional/business-style fare class for Wilson-Arusha. Child rates, circuit discounts, and group discounts do NOT apply - adult and child are charged the SAME fare level on J Class (a notable exception to AirKenya's usual 70%-child-fare rule). Company may withdraw/amend/discontinue without notice.

circuitDiscounts.note: Applies to gross fares only, Airkenya network only (2027 wording narrows this from 2026's 'throughout Airkenya and its subsidiaries network' to 'Only on Airkenya Network' - a real scope narrowing worth flagging, not just a rewording, since it may exclude Regional Air/Aerolink-operated legs from the circuit discount in 2027 where they qualified in 2026).
circuitDiscounts.confidenceNote: 2027 collapses the 2026 two-tier structure (25% for 3-4 sectors, 30% for 5+) into a single flat 25% for 3+ sectors - the 5-sector 30% tier is GONE in 2027. This is a real reduction for large circuits, not an extraction error - double check with AirKenya if quoting a 5+-sector 2027 circuit.

groupDiscounts.fifteenPlusPax: 20% off gross fare, scheduled flights only
groupDiscounts.twentyPlusPax: 25% off gross fare, scheduled flights only
groupDiscounts.confidenceNote: Thresholds RAISED from 2026 (10+/16+) to 2027 (15+/20+) - fewer groups will qualify for either discount tier in 2027. Flag this change explicitly in any 2027 group quote.

childInfantPolicy.infantsUnder2: Free, provided they do not occupy a seat.
childInfantPolicy.exceptions: Does NOT apply to J Class (Arusha) - adult and child same fare. S Class policy on child fare not explicitly restated in the S Class sheet; assume standard 70% applies unless told otherwise [Inference].

otherTermsUnchangedFrom2026: Amendment/cancellation/no-show fee structure identical to 2026 ($50/$100 amendment tiers, $50/$100/no-refund cancellation tiers, $100 no-show revalidation fee, $20 refund admin fee + 5% PSP commission).
Baggage: 15kg soft bags, $5/kg excess, $50 flat 1-10kg pre-purchase bundle, freight seat = 75kg at child's rate + taxes.
Check-in: 60 min at Wilson/Arusha/Kisumu/Entebbe, 30 min at bush airstrips.
confidenceNoteGeneral: Because 2027 nett fares are identical to 2026 nett fares on almost every shared route, the REAL year-over-year price change for 2027 is entirely carried by the new fuel surcharge line - a quote built from nett-fare-only figures would understate the true 2027 cost by $25-50 per sector. Always include the fuel surcharge column when pricing a 2027 AirKenya itinerary.
